item.description:
Controller 1.0.26 improves browser tools and agent reliability.
- Browser actions can return a snapshot in the same call, with clearer controls and smaller responses. - Agents can use the browser console and upload files without opening a file dialog. - Shared native tool connections reduce per-thread overhead and improve retry guidance. - Pi records accepted prompts in the durable transcript, and stopped Antigravity turns settle more reliably.

Controller 1.0.25 improves thread handling, model controls, and file previews.
- Settled threads return to the inbox when you send a message or new work starts. - Cursor plan approval can continue implementation with your chosen model. - Thread titles can use attached images. - Pi work stays in feed order, with improved shell activity classification. - Refined context and model controls, transcript loading, and Quick Look previews.
ControllerMobile 1.0.14 also adds a preference for dismissing the composer keyboard.

# Controller 1.0.24
- Controller now speaks British English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese. - Dictation learns each project's names, files and terms, so words like ThreadStore, AGENTS.md and your models' names come out spelled right. - Dictation cleanup weighs the words the recognizer was unsure of and common developer mix-ups such as cache for cash, and learns from the words you correct before sending. - Each project gets a short on-device summary that dictation cleanup and chat titles use, without spending any account's tokens. - A long model name stacks above its effort in the composer, and the composer controls stay on one row.
